description: Adds an unpriced room under a property in the selected wedding. The property is named by the id of a place already in the wedding or by a name, which uses the place with that name or starts a new one; a room name is required. An id that names no place in the wedding returns a not-found result. The new room has no payment requirement. Results return the saved room and its place's id and name, and say whether the call created that place. A new place is ordered by name among places that have not been reordered, so it is listed first once the properties have been reordered. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

property_id.description: Identifier of a place already in the selected wedding, as an alternative to property_name.

property_name.description: The property this room belongs to, e.g. "Castel Fragsburg". A name no place has starts a new place. Either this or property_id.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.
